questions.q: Who was the founder of the Slave (Mamluk) dynasty?
questions.a: Qutbuddin Aibak founded the Slave dynasty. A wrong answer here suggests the student is mixing up the founders of the different dynasties, likely confusing Aibak with the later Khalji rulers.

questions.q: Why is Razia Sultan considered a unique figure in the history of the Delhi Sultanate?
questions.a: She was the only woman to ever rule the Delhi Sultanate. If a student answers incorrectly, it shows they are not distinguishing between the individual rulers and are perhaps ignoring the significance of gender roles in medieval governance.

questions.q: If you were living in the year 1300 CE, which dynasty would you be living under?
questions.a: You would be under the Khalji dynasty. To solve this, students should compare the date 1300 against the provided ranges (Slave: 1206-1290; Khalji: 1290-1320). A wrong answer suggests a failure to correlate dates with the dynasty timeline.

questions.q: Compare the roles of Jalaluddin Khalji and Alauddin Khalji. How do their positions differ in the history of their dynasty?
questions.a: Jalaluddin Khalji was the founder, while Alauddin Khalji was the most famous ruler who expanded the empire. A wrong answer shows a misunderstanding of the difference between "founding" an organization and "expanding" its influence.

questions.q: Does the Delhi Sultanate represent a single, unchanging family line? Justify your answer.
questions.a: No, it consisted of five different dynasties that replaced one another over 300 years. A wrong answer reveals the student thinks the "Sultanate" was one family tree rather than a sequence of different ruling houses.

questions.q: Create a mnemonic or a short story to help remember the names of the five dynasties in order: Mamluk, Khalji, Tughlaq, Sayyid, Lodi.
questions.a: A good response uses a memory trick like "My Kite Takes Some Light" (M-K-T-S-L). A poor answer simply lists the names without any structural memory aid, indicating difficulty in retention.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: The Delhi Sultanate refers to the period between 1206 and 1526 CE when five ______ dynasties ruled parts of India from their capital, Delhi.
Fill in the blank: Imagine you are building a tower made of five different colored blocks, where each block ______ a different ruling family.
Fill in the blank: By memorizing the order of these five families, you gain a map of ______ years of Delhi's history.
What must you be able to do to master this topic?
questions.a: The student must be able to name the five dynasties in chronological order and identify one major ruler associated with the Mamluk and Khalji dynasties.
